context_summary: This is an intentionally vulnerable task manager application built with Django that includes features for project and task management, file uploads, user profiles, and administrative controls. The application uses both session-based and JWT authentication but has numerous access control vulnerabilities including IDOR, missing authentication checks, privilege escalation opportunities, and insecure direct object references.

checks.name: Missing Authentication
checks.reason_for_status: Several views are missing authentication decorators despite handling sensitive operations, and some endpoints that should require authentication do not enforce it properly.

findings.observation: Function 'download_profile_pic' is missing @login_required decorator despite accessing user profile information that should be restricted to authenticated users
findings.needs_validation: Verify that this endpoint properly validates user authentication before serving profile pictures

findings.observation: Function 'profile_by_id' has @csrf_exempt decorator but lacks proper authentication enforcement for updating user profiles with potentially sensitive data
findings.needs_validation: Verify that this endpoint requires authentication and properly validates user ownership

findings.observation: Function 'reset_password' has @csrf_exempt decorator, but lacks proper authentication enforcement for password reset functionality
findings.needs_validation: Verify that this endpoint properly validates the reset token and user identity before allowing password reset

checks.name: Insecure Direct Object References / IDOR
checks.reason_for_status: Multiple views fetch objects by user-supplied ID without verifying ownership, creating opportunities for users to access unauthorized resources.

findings.observation: Function 'download' accepts file_id parameter directly from URL and only checks if user belongs to the project, but does not verify that the file belongs to the user's project
findings.needs_validation: Verify that file access is properly scoped to user's projects and that direct file access bypasses proper authorization controls

findings.observation: Function 'task_edit' accepts task_id parameter directly from URL and does not verify that the task belongs to the user's project
findings.needs_validation: Verify that task editing is properly scoped to user's projects and that task ownership is checked

findings.observation: Function 'task_delete' accepts task_id parameter directly from URL but does not verify ownership of the task or project
findings.needs_validation: Verify that task deletion is properly scoped and that authorization checks are performed before deletion

findings.observation: Function 'task_complete' accepts task_id parameter directly from URL but does not verify ownership of the task or project
findings.needs_validation: Verify that task completion is properly scoped and that authorization checks are performed

findings.observation: Function 'task_details' accepts task_id parameter directly from URL but lacks proper authorization checks for viewing task details
findings.needs_validation: Verify that task details are properly protected and that users can only view tasks they're assigned to

findings.observation: Function 'note_edit' accepts note_id parameter directly from URL but does not verify that the note belongs to the current user's task
findings.needs_validation: Verify that note editing is properly scoped to user's tasks and that authorization is enforced

findings.observation: Function 'note_delete' accepts note_id parameter directly from URL but does not verify that the note belongs to the current user's task
findings.needs_validation: Verify that note deletion is properly scoped and that authorization is enforced

checks.name: Privilege Escalation & FLAC
checks.reason_for_status: Several endpoints that should require elevated privileges lack proper authorization checks, and some POST/PUT/DELETE operations are missing auth checks present on GET.

findings.observation: Function 'manage_groups' allows POST operations to modify group assignments but lacks proper permission checks for the POST method, while GET requires 'auth.change_group' permission
findings.needs_validation: Verify that group management POST operations properly enforce administrative privileges

findings.observation: Function 'project_edit' uses @user_passes_test(can_edit_project) decorator but allows both GET and POST methods without consistent authorization checks throughout
findings.needs_validation: Verify that all project editing operations properly enforce edit permissions consistently

findings.observation: Function 'manage_projects' allows POST operations to assign users to projects but lacks proper permission checks for the POST method
findings.needs_validation: Verify that project assignment POST operations properly enforce administrative privileges

findings.observation: Function 'manage_tasks' allows POST operations to assign users to tasks but lacks proper permission checks for the POST method
findings.needs_validation: Verify that task assignment POST operations properly enforce appropriate permissions

checks.name: Parameter Tampering & Mass Assignment
checks.reason_for_status: Several views accept user-supplied parameters that could lead to mass assignment vulnerabilities if not properly sanitized.

findings.observation: Function 'profile_by_id' accepts 'groups', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'email', 'dob', 'ssn', 'password' parameters directly from POST data and processes them without proper validation or sanitization
findings.needs_validation: Verify that user profile updates properly validate and sanitize all input parameters

findings.observation: Function 'reset_password' accepts 'reset_token' from POST data and directly uses it for user identification without sufficient validation
findings.needs_validation: Verify that password reset tokens are validated properly and that user identity is confirmed

checks.name: Injection Vulnerabilities
checks.reason_for_status: Multiple instances of raw SQL queries and potential XSS vulnerabilities found.

findings.observation: Function 'download' uses direct SQL query construction with user-controlled variables (file_id) which creates potential SQL injection vulnerability
findings.needs_validation: Verify that SQL injection protections are in place for file download operations

findings.observation: Function 'project_details' uses raw SQL with user-controlled project_id parameter in extra() method which is vulnerable to SQL injection
findings.needs_validation: Verify that SQL injection protections are in place for project details queries

findings.observation: Function 'search' constructs raw SQL query with user-controlled input without proper escaping
findings.needs_validation: Verify that search queries properly escape user input to prevent SQL injection

findings.observation: Function 'forgot_password' constructs raw SQL query with user-controlled email parameter without escaping
findings.needs_validation: Verify that email queries properly escape user input to prevent SQL injection

findings.observation: Function 'ping' accepts IP parameter directly from POST and constructs shell command without proper sanitization
findings.needs_validation: Verify that shell command execution properly sanitizes user input to prevent command injection

checks.name: Security Misconfigurations & CSRF
checks.reason_for_status: Multiple endpoints have @csrf_exempt decorators and missing CSRF protection on state-changing operations.

findings.observation: Function 'profile_by_id' has @csrf_exempt decorator but handles sensitive user profile updates that should be CSRF protected
findings.needs_validation: Verify that sensitive user profile update operations are properly protected against CSRF attacks

findings.observation: Function 'reset_password' has @csrf_exempt decorator and handles critical password reset functionality
findings.needs_validation: Verify that password reset operations are properly protected against CSRF attacks

findings.observation: Function 'change_password' has @csrf_exempt decorator and handles sensitive password change functionality
findings.needs_validation: Verify that password change operations are properly protected against CSRF attacks

findings.observation: Function 'forgot_password' has @csrf_exempt decorator and handles sensitive password recovery functionality
findings.needs_validation: Verify that password recovery operations are properly protected against CSRF attacks

findings.observation: Function 'ping' has @csrf_exempt decorator and handles potentially dangerous command execution
findings.needs_validation: Verify that command execution operations are properly protected against CSRF attacks

checks.name: Forced Browsing & Obscurity
checks.reason_for_status: Several admin and privileged URL patterns are accessible without explicit authorization checks.

findings.observation: Function 'view_all_users' uses @user_passes_test(lambda u: u.is_superuser) but allows access to all users' data without proper authorization scope enforcement
findings.needs_validation: Verify that superuser access to all users is properly protected and authorized

findings.observation: URL pattern for viewing all users (/taskManager/view_all_users/) is accessible via direct URL access without proper authorization enforcement
findings.needs_validation: Verify that direct access to admin endpoints is properly secured

findings.observation: URL pattern for managing groups (/taskManager/manage_groups/) is accessible via direct URL access without proper authorization enforcement
findings.needs_validation: Verify that direct access to group management is properly secured
